message.value: "A word is a direction." (Essence, ≤5 words in the study brief's form: 'Words become directions, not labels.') The one learning sentence (T-17), in the script doc's viewer restatement: "A computer turns a word into a list of numbers. One number only ranks words; two numbers give each word an arrow from the origin, and words that point the same way are related; real models use thousands of numbers, so a word is a direction in a high-dimensional semantic space — and any text, even an instruction, has a direction too."
